About the Project

IDCORE is an industry-linked doctoral training route in offshore renewable energy. The qualification is an EngD, with research and training connected to offshore energy challenges. Overseas applicants have a specific early deadline and a limited number of funded places.

Research Areas

  • Offshore renewable energy
  • Engineering
  • Industrial research

Funding and Duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionEngD studentship
Stipend / salary£21,805/year (UKRI minimum stipend 2026/27)
DurationFour-year EngD programme

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsUK and overseas applicants; home closing dates differ; overseas places limited and ATAS may apply.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round30 November 2026 (overseas/EU applicants)
LocationUnited Kingdom

About the University of Edinburgh

Edinburgh offers postgraduate research across science, engineering, humanities and health. Its collaborative doctoral programmes include industry-linked training, with admission and funding decisions made through the relevant programme.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://idcore.ac.uk/information-applicants

Source: idcore.ac.uk - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 30 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 30 November 2026 (overseas/EU applicants). Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗
